payload.title: The edge release signs with cosign's legacy .sig and .pem outputs while the repository's four other signing workflows use the Sigstore bundle, so the edge release is held on the cosign v2 line, which stops receiving signing-tool updates, until the manifest, the Sens enterprise release gate and the operator runbooks move to the bundle format
evidence: .github/workflows/edge-agent-release.yml:361 (cosign-release v2.6.5: the pin that keeps the legacy outputs working)
tools/gates/sens-enterprise-validation.ts:719-720 (the gate pins the .sig and .pem manifest fields)
.github/workflows/backup-production.yml:500 (the bundle format the other workflows already use: --bundle with a sigstore.json file)
payload.rule_violated: One signing format across the repository's releases (CLAUDE.md one owner per concept): a release that signs in a deprecated format needs an owner and a date for moving to the maintained one.
payload.notes: Close condition: the edge release signs with --bundle, the release manifest lists the bundle instead of the signature and certificate files, tools/gates/sens-enterprise-validation.ts and its self-test pin the new fields, edge-gateway-ota.md, edge-gateway-rc4-operator.md and sens-api-gateway/docs/deployment/install.md verify with --bundle, the cosign-release pin and tests/invariants/edge-release-cosign-contract.spec.ts are removed in the same change, and a release (or a dry run that signs a test blob) proves it. Not done in the rc.8 change: the move changes the signature contract the field devices and operators verify against, which needs the operator's decision and a release that exercises it.
